result.rationale: The diff shows remove_member uses `group.users.delete(user_id)` bypassing group.add/remove and any model callbacks, and the frontend now relies on user_count from `result.meta.total` for pagination totals (groups_controller#members uses `group.users.count`). If Group maintains a user_count via callbacks/counter cache (as add_members' use of `group.add(user)` + `group.save` implies), users.delete would leave counts stale. Whether a counter cache exists isn't fully verifiable from the diff, so moderate confidence.
